Due to ongoing construction, there is no direct access route between Substation Alpha and Substation Beta.  
Furthermore, because of scheduling conflicts, exactly one of the following two routes must be included in the inspection circuit: the route between Substation Beta and Gamma, or the route between Substation Gamma and Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a tour that inspects each substation precisely once and returns to the starting point.
